audience: Nobody should buy Tome from this page, because there is nothing to buy that we could open. The verdict is the whole story: no price to publish. On 14 October 2026, tome.app and its pricing URL did not resolve. If you landed here from a roundup, the useful act is to look at a tool whose pricing page returned a price.

A past user who still has an account is not who this review can help. We cannot see a plan, a credit, or a checkout. Pending is the rating because the site failed, not because the product was judged and found wanting. A dead pricing URL is not a Skip. It is an absence.
features: There is no feature list we are willing to sell you. Older write-ups described Tome as an AI presentation tool. That history is not a current spec. The only checked fact is that the site and the pricing URL returned errors.

The cons line is the feature, unfortunately: the pricing page returned deployment not found. tome.app and https://tome.app/pricing returned HTTP 404. https://tome.com/pricing returned HTTP 500. Three checks, no plan table.

If Tome comes back, this page should grow a real feature section and a price. Until then, pretending to review a generator we could not load would be filler, and filler is the thing this site is trying not to publish.
limitations: You cannot compare Tome on price. There is no price. Any dollar figure on another site is not confirmed here. We will not repeat one.
A 404 on the app and a 500 on the other domain means we also cannot confirm that a login still works. Do not migrate a deck into a URL that did not resolve on the day we checked.
Pending means check again later. It does not mean the product is recommended, and it does not mean it is condemned. It means we refuse to invent a plan.

faqs.q: Should I enter a credit card on a mirror site?
faqs.a: No. If the official pricing URL does not resolve, do not pay a lookalike. Use Beautiful.ai or Gamma, which we could at least request.

faqs.q: Will this page get a price later?
faqs.a: Only if we can read one on the vendor's site. We will not backfill a number from an old review.
